ui.summary: Added a read-only Projects root beside Pi and Claude (roots nav strip; /projects routes for project -> workflow -> run -> node), with contract-validated fetching (contracts/projects/v1.ts and contracts/workflow/v1.ts via Zod), pinned-definition DAG graph with keyboard access, run list with paging, node detail showing status meaning, graph attempt vs result attempt, explicit reuse evidence from result_reused events, checks with exit codes and on-demand log text, changed files, open assumptions, screenshots (image only) and per-node events; loading, empty-project vs empty-run, not-found, network/5xx/malformed-payload error views with Retry; no launch/approve/retry/delete controls; Back/Forward, existing file operations and unsaved-edit guards preserved; narrow single-column layout. Files: src/App.tsx, src/App.css, src/graph/model.ts, src/graph/Breadcrumbs.tsx, src/projects/{routes,api,status,dag,useResource}.ts, src/projects/{panels,WorkflowGraph,NodeDetail,RunView,ProjectsView}.tsx, tests/project-workflows/{playwright.config,global-teardown,harness,fixtures,mock,seed,projects.spec}.ts. Checks executed in this worktree after npm ci: npm run build (exit 0); npm run test:unit (130 pass, 0 fail); npx --no-install playwright test --config=tests/project-workflows/playwright.config.ts with WORKFLOW_VERIFICATION_PHASE=worker (6 passed, one screenshot:<id> PNG per scenario, also verified with --reporter=json/--output/--workers=1/--retries=0 and PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_FILE; temp roots removed); root regression specs tests/graph, document-failure, edit-recovery, locations (44 passed). Candidate phase NOT verified successfully: the backend is absent in this worktree; a candidate-phase probe started both servers with the seeded registry and failed only on /api/projects returning 404.
open_assumptions: Candidate-mode seeding (tests/project-workflows/seed.ts) follows the documented run-state.json/plan.json/packet.json layout from features/project-workflows/README.md and workflow/checks.py; the real adapter's registry validation, packet resolution and result/artifact URL naming are unverified here.

Candidate-mode evidence assertions discover which snapshot nodes carry result_uri via the real API and require at least one result with a screenshot artifact and check logs; reuse evidence in candidate mode accepts either an explicit reuse list or the explicit 'no reuse evidence' statement because the adapter's mapping of persisted events to result_reused is undefined.

Only results whose result_uri starts with the run's own /results/ route are fetched; artifacts are fetched only via /artifacts/{artifact_id}. Definition revisions are displayed and validated for summary/definition consistency but not recomputed client-side.
WORKFLOW_VERIFICATION_PHASE unset defaults to worker mode; any other value fails the config load.
Pinned-vs-current comparison uses the workflow list's definition_revision for the same workflow_id; the succeeded fixture run differs by one label so the notice is exercised in both phases.

adapter.summary: Implemented the project registry and read-only project/workflow/run API on the existing Fastify server. New: server/projectsConfig.ts (MD_MANAGER_PROJECTS_CONFIG loader in the README shape; unset = empty registry, explicit invalid file fails startup; ID/path/overlap/graph validation; canonical-JSON SHA-256 definition revisions verified byte-equal to Python json.dumps), server/projects.ts (run discovery under configured runs_root only, no-follow bounded reads of run-state.json/plan.json/events.jsonl/packets, hash-verified packet registry, state projection with task-error > interrupt > confirmed evidence > event precedence, paused on contradictions, succeeded only when integrated with nothing pending, worker-result and artifact projection with scoped URLs and path redaction), server/projectRoutes.ts (all seven contract routes under /api/projects, {error:{code,message}} shape, 400/404/405/5xx semantics, keyset cursors, response validation against the committed schemas, safe artifact content types with nosniff/CSP sandbox), config/projects.example.json, server/projects.test.ts (22 tests on disposable roots). Modified: server/app.ts (optional createApp projects/runStore options, plugin registration, maxParamLength 256 and frameworkErrors shaping), server/index.ts (registry loading at startup). Checks actually executed in this worktree after npm ci: backend-unit (npx --no-install tsx --test server/projects.test.ts: 22/22 pass), backend-regression (npm run test:unit: 130/130 pass), shared-contract (npm run test:contracts: 10/10 pass), backend-build (npm run build: exit 0), plus eslint on changed files (clean) and a manual startup smoke test of server/index.ts with invalid, missing, valid and unset registry files. No commits, pushes, agent launches or edits outside server/ and config/projects.example.json.
open_assumptions: Launch nodes (kind worker) link result_uri to the worker's latest worker-phase verification result once its packet exists (same URI as the verify node); their status still only means a session launched.
Candidate-phase packets are exposed as results under node IDs candidate_ui/candidate_adapter; the candidate graph node itself has result_uri null because it has two packets.
Events are read from events.jsonl when present (export copy is the fallback); a run's updated_at is the later of the export updated_at and the newest persisted event time.

A malformed run-state.json in any run directory makes that workflow's run list a 500 RUN_STORAGE_INVALID naming the directory basename, rather than silently skipping it; directories with only plan.json are skipped from lists with a server-log warning and are 404 RUN_UNSUPPORTED on direct access.

Blocked verification packets are served as WorkerResult status failed with error code VERIFICATION_BLOCKED (the producer stores result.status succeeded with the gate separately); blank open_assumptions strings are dropped to satisfy the contract.
Fastify maxParamLength was raised to 256 and a frameworkErrors handler added app-wide; legacy routes keep Fastify's default router-error body and all existing tests still pass.
A configured runs_root is not required to exist at startup; an unusable root is 503 RUNS_ROOT_UNAVAILABLE per request, never an empty list.
Unattributed raw events (unknown node alias) are emitted as type log with node_id and status null rather than inventing a graph node.
